reviews.text:
We’ve been taking our Aussie to Honourable Hound for all of the puppy classes and have done some private training. Both have proven to be an incredible experience. In classes, we worked with Tracey and Matt to learn some skills that were both fun for the dog and useful for navigating life. During our first class, I can honestly say I thought we would never make it through the classes, let alone where we are today. I remember visiting Tracey in an office hour and she encouraged us to stick with it and to also find ways to help make the class experience for our puppy more effective. In terms of the puppy socialization, Tracey helped us find better pairings with other dogs so his experience was more positive. He is quite rambunctious and really just wants to interact with every dog and person, so while the in-class dividers helped him focus somewhat he often would get frustrated not being in on the action. Tracey encouraged us to take Barlow outside of our dedicated training area and work with him in a more open setting so he didn’t feel as boxed in. As he got older and we progressed through classes, this became slightly less of an issue but I believe Tracey and Matt’s responsivity to our dog definitely helped him be more successful in class. Our little guy definitely grew fond of Matt, which made us jump at the chance to work with Matt in private training. Here we really honed in more on “real world” experiences that our dog struggled with and I know we now feel far more confident in our approach. There are still struggles with having a high energy Aussie and I think anyone who expects miracles to be worked over night because you work with a trainer is viewing these experiences through the wrong lens. Our goal was to strengthen our skills and develop a strong working relationship with our dog, while still having fun with him during this age.  I believe Honourable Hound helped us achieve that.

Other perks of committing to training were that it gave us a routine during a time when having a puppy felt chaotic. Additionally, it helped tire him out so we got some peace for a few hours afterwards.

As a first time dog owner, they have been the most helpful. I signed up for the puppy elementary classes and I’m happy with my experience! Each lesson taught valuable core values for puppies. They offer various levels based on age, and will be attending the junior high courses next. I will vouch heavily for Jacqueline and her team!

This is an awesome organization, their training methods are well thought out and easy to understand, and you can tell how much they care about the dogs and their owners! We’d recommend Puppy Elementary to anyone.
My puppy and I have really enjoyed our classes with HH, through the three levels/age groups we've done. Especially appreciate the opportunity to attend office hours.

Great experiences with Nina for private training! Group classes- mentally prepare yourself lol. I found the puppy elementary to be a bit too much of a breakneck pace with my high-energy rescue puppy, but the calmer/shyer dogs there seemed to be able to focus easier, and the fundamental skills we learned were helpful for me as an owner, to practice at home with my dog. For dog owners, ensure you give yourself plenty of time to get there and have a pee break before start time (I thought evenings would work but with traffic and only 60 min lesson time, we were not making the best of our time- weekend would have been better). We got a "report card" at the end which was a bit rushed and filled out in-class that day, but the online drop-in sessions allowed us to ask specific questions about our dog. Overall everyone is super friendly, understanding, and knowledgeable. Like with all things dog, you as an owner need to be regulated in order to learn and make progress.
Had an amazing experience with honourable hound! Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for some puppy training classes

Was such a great thing to do with my dog. The class progression gave both of us much needed confidence and built on the previous classes. Highly recommended if you want to bond with your dog and give them a challenge.
Great experience doing the urban hunting class with Honourable Hounds. I wasn’t sure about signing up with my reactive dog, but this class was perfect for her!
Great place

Working with Jacqueline for my spicy, reactive dog has been fantastic. My dog bonded with her right away, and we’ve already seen real progress in a short amount of time. Jacqueline clearly knows reactivity training inside and out, and she built a flexible, well-thought-out program that made the whole process genuinely enjoyable.

5 Stars ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I can't say enough good things about Honourable Hounds Dog Training. What really sets them apart is their deep understanding of different dog breeds and the unique traits, instincts, and learning styles that come with each one. They don't take a one-size-fits-all approach. Instead, they tailor their training sessions to the individual dog, which makes a huge difference in both progress and confidence.

Another standout feature is the small class sizes. Because there are only a few dogs in each session, every owner and dog receives plenty of individual attention and personalized guidance. The trainers take the time to answer questions, provide specific feedback, and adjust techniques as needed.

The supportive, knowledgeable, and positive training environment has made learning enjoyable for both my dog and me. If you're looking for a training program that combines expertise, personalized instruction, and genuine care for your dog's success, I highly recommend Honourable Hounds.
Thank you Jacqueline and team, our pup is still learning but has seen some huge improvements in a manner of weeks

I've been taking the Nosework class at Honourable Hound and I think it's great--but more importantly, my dog gets excited as soon as we approach the building and then has so much fun from the start to finish of every class.
Excellent class. My pup was exhausted after every session. Good basic training and helpful reminders for people wanting well behaved pups!
My dog hasn't had that much fun in a long time!

We did one on one classes as well as Canine High school with Jacqueline. We have a rescue pup who went from being afraid of nearly everything outside to a much more confident and happy boy. The instructions, information, and training gave us the tools and know how to navigate a stressful time and it's been so much fun to see Iggy grow into a loving, playful, and very dog friendly pup. Iggy also absolutely adored Jacqueline, which was cute and useful for teaching him new tricks.
Very professional and knowledgeable. Loved them.
Took my shy chihuahua to the puppy drop in socialization class and it was a gentle and thoughtful approach to building her confidence!

I attended Sat puppy classes with Tracey Harrison and found them incredibly helpful. Some of the things I particularly liked:
- short classes: out of 50 min class maybe 20-30min are spent working with the dog - which is more than enough for a puppy.
- clear instructions and tailored advice: when practicing exercises in class , there is always a trainer or a volunteer observing and guiding you.
- calm and understanding trainers, good setup for the dogs and overall easy and chill leaning environment.
Initially I signed up mainly for play time with other puppies which turned out to be the least important part of the class. Though at first disappointed about not being able to find my dog any friends, I later realized that the dog training aspect of the class was far more valuable.
I am not sure why but most of the things my dog knows were learnt there. I guess it was just another reminder for me that TikTok university is not a replacement for teachers. We learn from personal interactions with other humans. And in this case I learnt a little bit of dog training . it really improved my life and I hope my dogs life as well.

My dog Allie loves her Urban Hunting classes at Honourable Hound. It’s become our favorite evening of the week. The team has been super helpful and accommodating as well. Highly recommend the classes!

Honourable Hound really care about the health of your pet and the trainers work focus hard on building a good relationship between guardian and pet through their techniques, exercises and guidance. I also found them to be extra supportive of the guardian as we often are the ones needing more training to understand our beloved pets!

The private trainer was very professional, arrived at our home on time, was excellent with Poppy (golden retriever) and made Poppy feel relaxed from the beginning. Had excellent suggestions, answered all my questions and was very thorough. Very happy with session, also happy I can email the trainer with questions and to update her on Poppy's progress.

Honourable hound has helped me tremendously with my dog. I have worked personally with Holly and she has provided me great support and ideas to help train my dog in the areas I needed help. I would recommend this dog trainer to anyone needing help with their dog training
The group classes have been  great learning for us and our pupils!

I honestly couldn’t recommend these Puppy Elementary classes more highly. I’ve been taking my 3.5-month-old puppy, and the sessions are incredibly well balanced, there’s a great mix of instruction for us as owners and hands-on engagement with our puppies. It never feels overwhelming, and everything is explained in a way that’s easy to understand and apply at home.

My favourite part is the supervised puppy play. Being able to watch the puppies interact safely and appropriately is amazing, and I’ve already seen such a difference in my puppy’s confidence after just one week. It’s been so reassuring to see him grow and become more comfortable in new environments.

The classes are also excellent value for money. You get so much more than just basic training, you gain a real understanding of why you’re training in a certain way, which makes it much easier to stay consistent. Everything is based on positive reinforcement, which was really important to me, and it creates such a supportive and encouraging environment for both puppies and owners.

I’m so glad we enrolled, it’s been one of the best investments I’ve made for my puppy’s development.

I saw Holly for 7 sessions to try to address dog reactivity for my young German shepherd. It was largely unsuccessful but there were a few things that I think are important to point out.

Pros:
Holly is lovely and she did give us some good tips on how to calm her down in the house to improve focus and relax.
We did get some good tips on door greetings with visitors.

Cons:
We spent almost the entirety of our sessions indoors. We spent probably a total of 45 minutes outdoors and didn’t even leave the house until our 3rd visit.
For me it only makes sense to actually assess a problem to be able to view a dogs behaviour so you know what you’re trying to change.
We were basically told the recycled “distance, distraction, avoid” lines, which can be helpful but we were given very little instruction or change to instruction when things were not progressing well.

This review is to point out that I think Holly is well suited to some aspects of dog training, for us she provided very little help dealing with reactivity and I was very disappointed with the lack of time spent actually looking at my dogs behaviour and mostly just talking in our house each time.

Lastly I think the “subscription” is a bit of tip off, if you need a rolling subscription to a dog trainer, it’s likely the results are going to come very slowly.

My pup absolutely loved her classes with Holly. She learned so much, and I feel more confident as her owner too. Holly, as well as the rest of the staff, was patient, kind, and made training fun for both of us. Highly recommend!

The Intro to Nosework class has been great for our reactive dog. It's a safe place for him to work and search for food. Kayleigh has been a wonderful instructor and we're looking forward to the Continuing Nosework classes.
We've been very happy with Honourable Hound's trainers. We've done private lessons with Marysha and also did the reactive club with her also. Very patient and professional. Thank you to all the trainers at Honourable Hound!

The beginner nose work classes at Honourable Hound are super fun and engaging—the pace was perfect and the instruction clear and easy to follow. I also really appreciated being able to easily translate the exercises to my own living environment and to the outdoors.
Incredible class, very friendly people. lots of fun

Honourable hounds has been amazing for our puppy training experience. All the instructors we've interacted with have been amazingly calm and confident and they have great practical advice for any hick-ups along the way. Our puppy has really responded to the techniques they support and the positive training method has never led us astray. They also all clearly love dogs and are excited to be there with everyone. We will continue to do more advanced classes there just for fun!

Masina helped my emotional bulldog begin to learn to be calm. Her training was really easy and practical and built around my real life which I really appreciated. She gave me clear schedules and tactics to help my bully relax and self-soothe. Since our training she’s been more calm, less reactive, and easier to handle. Really appreciated her kind and realistic approach. Thanks again!

Instructor good at drawing my dog into this experience and helping him engage and enjoy the nose work. I was pleasantly surprised that he was able to focus better than I expected given how excited he normally gets! He really enjoyed it - and he was nice and tired afterward 😊 …

I recently completed training with Honorable Hound and it was a great experience. The guidance was practical, clear, and easy to apply with my six month old puppy. I am still implementing what I learned, and even in this short time I can already see positive changes in manners. The techniques feel realistic for everyday life, which makes it much easier to stay consistent. Overall, it has been a very helpful and supportive service for both me and my pup.
Such a great class. Instructors are very knowledgeable and helpful. Love the office hours help as well.

Holly and her team do an excellent job of sharing information and helping you understand the fundamentals of raising and training your puppy. The group class we attended was the perfect size—small enough to feel almost private. The instructions were clear and effective, and we saw real results. Our dog loved the playtime and the treats, too! They truly set you and your dog up for success. Highly recommend!

Class is well organized with friendly instructors who gave helpful instructions on puppy behaviour. Favourite part is puppy playtime which they try to match similiar puppy sizes. Would recommend this place to new puppy owners.
Friendly and professional instructors! Very patient with each dog
Great experience with Holly and staff at Honourable Hound. Our chaotic puppy is better behaved because of this course. Thank you!!
Amazing trainers, felt really comfortable!
Very kind and professional service, really appreciate the focus on achievable steps and setting families and their dogs up for success.

My dog Umi had a great time learning with Holly and the other instructors. Now that she is in a teenager phase it was nice to be able to know how to curb those emotions and handle her tendencies to pull on the leash. We will need to keep on working on her recall and maintaining her calmness around distractions. I do appreciate the office hours that are held for the students weekly.

We have been working with Nina for the past couple months with our two year old reactive miniature dachshund. It has been such a positive experience and have had noticed such improvement with his anxiety. It’s so nice to be able to see our little guy enjoy walks again. She provides plans and insight into his behaviour, gives us instructions on what to work on after our sessions and the why behind it. Worth every penny!
The combination of training experience and behavioural understanding is simply unmatched. I only wish that I had started with them sooner.

My 7 month old pup and I had a great experience working with Maraysha. I feel
Confident that the training plan she put together will help us grow our girl up into an amazing dog.

Holly gives very practical exercises that you can easily incorporate into your daily routine with your dog, and the exercises all blend with each other. We are planning on continuing Gus' training and also get him in group training and classes.

Photo of Gus watching a pack of dogs more calmly - which was not the case prior to Honourable Hound.

Just finished puppy elementary and so pleased with the progress we've seen already. Signed up for the Jr. High classes and planning on more after that. Sarah and Catrina are so patient and lovely to work with, Vaquita really liked them both. Sad the puppy socials are no more since we live across the street, but still happy clients!

Holly was so flexible and created a customized intensive program for my pup while we were in town for work for 2 months. My dog Twiggy was so excited to see Holly every day, which shows that the training experience was so pleasant for her while she was learning.
Holly is so knowledgeable about dog behavior and is both kind and direct with the dog and their people! I found our sessions so informative and she always used a gentle approach. If we ever find ourselves in Vancouver again, we will definitely be calling her to polish up on our skills.
I wish we could have taken Holly home to NY with us! Highly recommend using the Honorable Hound, it was such a positive experience for everyone!

I have had an excellent experience with Honourable Hound. I wanted to work on recall, loose leash walking and a few other things with my sighthound puppy. My puppy is very sensitive and Nina was able to work with him very well and built breaks into our training sessions to allow him time to reset between practicing different tasks. Nina is very knowledgeable, patient, accommodating and easy to get in contact with if you need additional support. I would highly recommend Honourable Hound's private training with Nina.
fun and informative! We really enjoyed the puppy elementary class with our new pup!
We have taken several classes here and really like them. Our puppy is learning a lot!
Puppy Elementary was such a great experience for our pup and us humans alike. We learned so much and feel that we have a really good foundation to keep building on!

We came in with concerns about our new dog coming to live downtown after a quiet and sheltered start to life. Nina was wonderful throughout the whole process, providing detailed training plans each week and answering all of our questions. We've got lots of work ahead but with a clear plan and direction thanks to our month of sessions
The quality of the trainers is excellent and everyone on the team is incredibly supportive. I would recommend them to anyone getting started with a puppy, especially if its their first time!
I’ve just started with Maraysha but I have a really good feeling! She’s friendly, approachable and knowledgeable!!! Highly recommend!

I just completed a Tricks class with Sarah, and it was great! She was very considerate of my dogs needs, gave great tips and provided strong foundations for how to teach your dog tricks. My dog learned some great little tricks and i always felt like I could ask questions and get great support.

Nina & Holly were extremely helpful to us as new dog owners. Our pup gets nervous around other dogs, they gave us lots of great advice and came on a walk with us to give personalized suggestions and recommendations. Looking forward to seeing them again soon!

Highly recommend the Intro to Tricks class at Honourable Hound for anyone who’s looking for a fun challenge with their dog! Sarah the instructor is the most patient and thoughtful trainer. She provided customized tips for my 9 year old dog, Cody, and shared lots of detailed training materials. Cody learned so many new tricks & had the best time taking classes at Honourable Hound!!! 🐶

UPDATE: 3 years later and we've taken multiple classes and workshops with Honourable Hound. I especially appreciated Sarah's adaptability in explaining alternative methods to match the strengths and challenges of each dog.  Will happily enroll in another class soon!

Holly is a sea of calm and practical, easy to apply advice to help transform your baby velociraptor to a well behaved pup.  I especially appreciate Holly's compassion and understanding when she's coaching me through difficult patches when things seem a little overwhelming and emotional.

I cannot say enough good things about our experience with Honourable Hounds. We are first time dog owners and the help that we have received has been invaluable.
